<documents>
<document id="transfers-recurring">
ScheduledˆandˆrecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆscheduleˆaˆtransferˆforˆaˆfutureˆdate,ˆorˆsetˆoneˆupˆtoˆrepeatˆweekly,ˆeveryˆtwoˆweeksˆorˆmonthly.ˆ##ˆSetˆoneˆupˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆaccount,ˆenterˆtheˆamount,ˆandˆtapˆSchedule.ˆPickˆtheˆdateˆandˆhowˆoftenˆitˆrepeats.ˆ##ˆWhenˆscheduledˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆOnˆtheˆscheduledˆdate,ˆACHˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆinˆtheˆbatchˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆET.ˆIfˆtheˆdateˆfallsˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆthey'reˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆNotˆenoughˆmoneyˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆtooˆlowˆonˆtheˆsendˆdate,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆskippedˆandˆweˆnotifyˆyou.ˆWeˆdon'tˆretryˆit,ˆandˆthere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆFutureˆtransfersˆinˆtheˆseriesˆstillˆrun.ˆ##ˆChangeˆorˆstopˆEditˆorˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtimeˆbeforeˆtheˆcutoffˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆ##ˆTransfersˆtoˆsavingsˆRecurringˆtransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆhappenˆinstantlyˆonˆtheˆscheduledˆday,ˆincludingˆweekends.ˆScheduledˆtransfersˆcountˆtowardˆyourˆdailyˆandˆmonthlyˆtransferˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆdayˆthey'reˆsent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="plan-fee-refunds">
RefundsˆofˆplanˆfeesˆWeˆrefundˆtheˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆchargeˆonˆyourˆaccountˆinˆfullˆifˆyouˆleaveˆtheˆpaidˆplanˆwithinˆ14ˆdaysˆofˆthatˆcharge.ˆWeˆcallˆthisˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod.ˆ##ˆHowˆitˆworksˆ-ˆItˆappliesˆonlyˆtoˆtheˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆchargeˆyourˆaccountˆhasˆeverˆhad.ˆLaterˆcharges,ˆevenˆafterˆswitchingˆplans,ˆaren'tˆcovered.ˆ-ˆWhenˆyouˆaskˆforˆtheˆrefund,ˆyourˆplanˆreturnsˆtoˆBasicˆrightˆawayˆratherˆthanˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ-ˆTheˆrefundˆgoesˆbackˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆusuallyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆWhatˆisn'tˆrefundedˆOutsideˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod,ˆplanˆfeesˆaren'tˆrefundedˆorˆprorated.ˆThatˆincludesˆtheˆmonthˆinˆwhichˆyouˆdowngradeˆandˆtheˆmonthˆinˆwhichˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆaskˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆcancelˆyourˆpaidˆplanˆunderˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod.ˆSupportˆcanˆprocessˆitˆforˆyouˆstraightˆaway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
